attributes.name: The Fulsome Queen
attributes.powers: At the start of your turn, reveal this card and examine the top 3 cards of your location deck. Banish any non-villain, non-henchmen banes that have the Demon trait, then recharge this card. If there are no such cards to banish, give this card to a random other character; you are dealt 1d4 poison damage.
